name: LaBeau's Golden Fried Halibut & French Fries Basket
brandOrRestaurant: LaBeau's Drive-In (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Pacific halibut is an ultra-lean, flaky white fish with zero connective tissue; peeling off part of the crispy batter and skipping lemon wedges makes this classic Bear Lake basket manageable in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Halibut & Fries basket with no lemon wedge; peel away thick edges of fried batter if your stomach is sensitive to fryer oil.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter and fries add fryer oil fat
Skip lemon wedges (citrus trigger) and relish-heavy tartar sauce
